transcript_raw:
Participant: P08 | Session 1 | Cyberpunk 2077 | full HUD | Interviewer: Researcher 2
[00:00] Interviewer: Okay [name], thanks. Let's start the interview for session 1.
[00:10] Interviewer: Q1. How did you figure out where to go during the session? What did you look at or rely on?
[00:18] P08: uhm ahh, I kept looking you know, at the waypoint marker and drove toward it.
[00:38] Interviewer: Q2. Were there moments when something on the screen confused you? What was happening?
[00:44] P08: ahh, like, [silence 6s] not really, everything was pretty clear. Like I said, I'm [participant], I play this at home.
[01:11] Interviewer: Q3. Which HUD elements, if any, pulled your attention away from what you were doing?
[01:15] P08: like, you know, my eyes kept going to the minimap corner um, instead of the road.
[01:36] Interviewer: Q4. Was there any HUD element that didn't work the way you expected?
[01:44] P08: um, uhm the marker got confusing when like, I was inside a building.
[01:59] Interviewer: Q5. How aware were you of the passing of time while playing?
[02:05] P08: uh, uhm honestly time went by fast. My friend [name] told me it's the same in other games.
[02:39] Interviewer: Q6. Was there a point where you had to stop to figure out what the game was telling you?
[02:47] P08: um, like, [silence 3s] no, I never really had to um, stop, the map told me everything.
[03:03] Interviewer: Q7. What information, if any, did you feel was missing from the screen?
[03:07] P08: you know, uhm [silence 8s] nothing was missing, if anything there was too much. I usually stream as [username] so I play a lot.
[03:25] Interviewer: Q8. What would you change about the HUD you just used, and why?
[03:32] P08: um, you know, I would make the HUD smaller and remove some of the notifications.
